(* Should have satisfactorily completed the works as mentioned below during the last seven years
ending last day of the month previous to the one in which tenders are invited.)
Three similar completed works each costing not less than Rs. 7.09 Lakhs
OR
Two similar completed works each costing not less than Rs. 10.64 Lakhs
OR
One similar completed work costing not less than Rs. 14.19 Lakhs.
Similar work shall mean "Repair/Maintenance/SITC of Fire Fighting equipment work.".
Note: The value of executed works shall be brought to current costing level by enhancing the
actual value of work at simple interest rate of 7% per annum; calculated from the date of
completion to previous day of last date of submission of bids.
B2 The bidder should have at least average annual financial turnover of Rs. 5.32 Lakhs
on construction works during the last three years ending 31 March 2024. (Scanned
copy of Certificate from CA with Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) to be
uploaded). The value of annual turnover figures shall be brought to the current value
by enhancing the actual turnover figure at simple rate of 7% per annum (on the
format prescribed in form A).
B3
Should not have incurred any loss (profit after tax should be positive) in more than two
years during the last five years ending 31st March, 2024 (on the format prescribed in
form A).
B4
Banker's Certificate of the amount equal to Rs. 7.09 Lakhs or Net worth Certificate of
minimum net worth of equal to Rs. 1.77 Lakhs issued by certified Chartered
Accountant with UDIN (on the format prescribed in form B or B1).
B5
Should have bidding capacity equal to or more than the estimated cost of the work put
to tender. The bidding capacity shall be worked out by the following formula:
Bidding Capacity = {[AxNx1.5]-B}
Where,
A = Maximum turnover in construction works executed in any one year during the last
seven years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. The
value of completed works shall be brought to current costing level by enhancing
at a simple rate of 7% per annum.
N = Number of years prescribed for completion of work for which bids have been
invited.
B = Value of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the
period of completion of work for which bids have been invited.
(on the format prescribed in form C3).
(Bidding capacity calculation shall be applicable as per DG, CPWD OM No. DG/SOP-
2024/20 dt.31.07.2025)
2.
The intending bidder must read the terms and conditions of CPWD-6 carefully. He
should only submit his bid if he considers himself eligible and he is in possession of all
the documents required.
3.
Information and Instructions for bidders posted on website shall form part of bid
document.

Name of Work: MOEI & fans in C/S Bldg. at South Block, New Delhi. (SH: Replacement
of existing damaged fire pipe line and accessories and servicing of Fire Pump.)
Terms & Conditions:
1.
The work shall be carried out strictly in conformity with the CPWD General Specification of
Electrical Works Part-I (Internal) 2023, and Part-II (External) 2023 for electrical works in force
and the Indian Electricity Rule - 1956, as amended upto date.
2.
All the materials, used by the contractor should be got approved from the Engineer-in-Charge or
his authorized representative before installation. No payment will be made for any unapproved or
sub-standard materials used on the work. Rejected materials should be removed from the site of
work within 48 hours, by the contractor.
3.
No T & P shall be issued by the department.
4.
Any damage to the installation/ building during execution of work shall be made good by the
contractor at his own cost. Repair work if any, should be done with proper cement and sand ratio
and to be match with existing finish.
5.
The rates quoted shall be inclusive of all taxes i.e GST but exclusive of ESI & EPF as it would be
reimbursed only (As applicable and eligible) after submitted proper documents of their deposits &
to the satisfaction of Engineer-in-charge.
6.
The work shall be carried out in security zone area; hence necessary passes shall have to be
arranged by the contractor within Three days award of work for the workers engaged by him.
7.
Lowest Bidder shall submit Police verification of staff/labourers to be employed at site within Five
days of the award of work, otherwise panelty of Rs. 500/- per day till submission of Police
verification of labourers and start of work. Pending or under process police verification will not be
accepted.
8.
The electrical work shall be done strictly in close co-ordination with civil works. No claim for idle
labour shall be entertained by the department.
9.
The firm shall submit the type test report for cable & other materials along with all necessary
documents like invoice etc. Earth wire to be connected with lugs & thimbles etc.
10.
No item shall be installed having Country of Origin in China.
11.
All termination of electrical cables for sizes higher than 4 Sq. mm shall have to be done with
proper thimbles / reducer. Copper thimble / reducer shall be used for copper cable and aluminum
ones for Al. cables. Nothing extra shall be paid by the department however end termination of
power cables shall be paid extra.
12.
Earth wire in the switch board/DB should be covered with green sleeve for which no extra payment
will be made.
13. Nothing extra shall be paid on account of dismantling the wire, conduit, fittings, fans, DB's &
Panel etc. and the same will be deposited to the JE's Store.
14.
All the debris etc. shall be removed from the site of work daily.
15.
Electricity & water shall be supplied by the department free of cost.
16.
The site in much secured important heritage building, so all related bye laws are to be followed.
17.
Normally execution will take place after office hours. & site for the work will be provided one by
one.
18.
The watch and ward of the materials installed will be the responsibility of the contractor till
handing over to the department on completion of work.
19.
Any accident at site during execution of work to be workman and to the third party shall be
responsibility of the contractor and claim if any arises due to such accident shall be on the part of
contractor and department shall not entertain any claim in this regard.
20.
Work will be carried out in the occupied building hence labour wastage may be there and no claim
in this regard from the contractor shall be entertain by the department.
21. The site will be provided as and when required.
